draft_copy.description_zh: 这件作品以端庄的孔子形象，表达对先贤与教育的敬意。印样题有“先师孔子行教像”，并以“德侔天地，道冠古今；删述六经，垂宪万世”的文字颂扬其学问与德行。通过雕版印刷，人物形象与文字一同留在纸上，让知识传承成为可见、可分享的故事。
draft_copy.description_en: This dignified portrait of Confucius honours learning and the passing on of knowledge. Its inscriptions praise his wisdom, virtue and lasting influence as a teacher. Printing brings the portrait and its words together on paper, giving this tribute a form that visitors can share.

draft_copy.title_en: Porcelain Motif: Fish and Good Fortune
draft_copy.description_zh: 这件作品以瓷瓶为轮廓，双鱼环绕中央的“福”字，周围饰以花卉纹样。“鱼”与“余”谐音，寄托“年年有余”的祝愿；“福”字则代表福气与好运。两种吉祥意象相伴，表达生活丰足、福气常在的美好心愿。
draft_copy.description_en: Within the outline of a porcelain vase, two fish surround the character fú (福), meaning good fortune or blessings. The Chinese words for fish and surplus share the pronunciation yú, so fish express a wish for abundance year after year. Together, the fish and fú offer wishes for a plentiful life and lasting good fortune.

artworks.story:
这两块雕版代表着中国非常重要的吉祥与神灵庇护的壁画，是典型的“左青龙，右白虎”，代表着保佑平安与成功。

这两个壁画其实都出自古代佛教石刻上的壁画。其中左侧青龙的形状来自壁画当中的青龙，而右侧的白虎也是来自于古代壁画当中的白虎形象。
artworks.story_summary: 一对“左青龙，右白虎”题材作品，寓意神灵庇护、平安与成功。

draft_copy.title_en: Chinese Dragon on a Covered Jar
draft_copy.description_zh: 这件作品以有盖罐为外形，将一条盘曲的中国龙融入器身装饰。龙在中国传统文化中是祥瑞的象征，常与护佑、幸福以及江河湖泊等水域相联系。龙纹也是中国陶瓷的传统装饰题材。盘曲的龙身与繁密的纹饰相结合，呈现出鲜明的动势。
draft_copy.description_en: This woodblock print depicts a coiling Chinese dragon within the outline of a covered jar. In Chinese tradition, dragons are auspicious creatures associated with protection, happiness and water. Dragon motifs are also a familiar feature of Chinese ceramics. The winding body and richly patterned decoration give the image a lively sense of movement.
